thermonuclear: Both run once at e918e183. Deep review: the proxy allow-list held against every bypass tried, and the forward merge e877dbf9 adds nothing beyond main and the conflict resolution. The pill's rule matched GitHub's statusCheckRollup on 39 of 39 recent sjawhar/legion pull requests. keyFindings.description: Line 86 sends GitHub's workflow-runs body to the browser unchanged. One run is about 12.8 KB, because it carries the full repository, head_repository and head_commit objects. gh api repos/sjawhar/legion/actions/runs?per_page=100 returned 1,291,575 bytes, more than client.go's responseLimit (1 MiB). So a head with about 82 or more runs gets 502 GITHUB_UPSTREAM, and the whole pill disappears where before it showed. The same body also gives any signed-in person commit messages and author and committer emails of private repositories, but the pill reads only check_suite_id, event and name. Fix: the proxy returns only those three fields of each run (with total_count).

Line 127 reads the check runs and the workflow runs in parallel. A workflow run created between the two reads has check runs with no matching workflow run. They then take the app key and skip the event filter, so the pill can show pending or failure until the next refetch. Fix: read the check runs first, then the workflow runs. A workflow run exists before its check runs, so every suite already seen matches.

Nothing runs the app-keyed branch (GitHubLink.tsx:84-90): every fixture has a matching workflow run. Add rows for an external App's check run with no workflow run: two runs of one name and App (older failed, newer passed -> success), and one name from two App ids (one failed -> failure). Docs: packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/AGENTS.md:376-388 and README.md:1173 must say that the pill drops runs of events GitHub does not evaluate, and that it needs the App's Actions: read (without it, actions/runs is 403 and the pill disappears).

fastFollow: Fake GitHub's check-run, workflow-run and pull shapes are written out in three files (export them from fake-github.ts, as fake-broker.ts does). proxy.go reads capture group 3 by position (use a named group). readEveryPage guesses the query separator from the path. The test 'keeps ... when only its check-runs lookup fails' fails both reads; rename it, or fail only actions/runs.
